description: This file defines the CausalClock class, which provides methods for generating and merging timestamp-based logical clocks within the Orleans.Transactions namespace.

classes.name: CausalClock
classes.description: A class that manages a causal clock for transaction ordering, providing methods to get the current timestamp and merge timestamps.

methods.name: CausalClock
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the CausalClock with an IClock instance.

methods.name: UtcNow
methods.description: Returns the current UTC timestamp, ensuring monotonicity.

methods.name: Merge
methods.description: Merges a given timestamp with the current clock state.

methods.name: MergeUtcNow
methods.description: Merges the current UTC time with a provided timestamp, ensuring causality.
